voltage-violet.$description: Voltage Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Mid-gradient stop in hero band and platform diagram backgrounds. Bridges Voltage Violet to darker violet depths

plum-voltage.$description: Plum Voltage — Deeper gradient stop, card-on-violet backgrounds in platform architecture diagram

royal-purple.$description: Royal Purple — Even deeper gradient stop; used in platform diagram cells and hero band lower section

indigo-abyss.$description: Indigo Abyss — Deepest gradient stop; anchors the bottom of the hero band and provides shadow depth in violet illustrations

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Soft violet tint — decorative washes, subtle highlights on violet illustrations, muted violet borders on light backgrounds

cobalt-vein.$description: Cobalt Vein — Slightly lighter violet stroke for illustration linework and decorative connectors in hero graphics

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text color on light backgrounds; near-black with a barely perceptible cool cast. Used for body copy and headings

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Dominant text and icon color across the entire interface. The workhorse neutral for headings, body, nav, and icon fills

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary heading weight and nav text; darker than mid-gray but lighter than Obsidian

slate.$description: Slate — Muted heading and button text on light surfaces; cool gray with blue undertone

iron.$description: Iron — Body text secondary level, descriptive paragraphs, and muted helper text. Highest frequency gray

steel.$description: Steel — Utility text and less-prominent body content; neutral mid-gray with no color cast

fog.$description: Fog — Icon strokes and decorative linework in illustrations

ash.$description: Ash — Light decorative strokes and illustration linework

mist.$description: Mist — Button borders on light surfaces; cool pale gray with slight blue cast

cloud.$description: Cloud — Dividers, subtle borders, and box-shadow base color; the universal hairline gray

ice.$description: Ice — Input borders and card edge dividers; slightly cooler than Cloud

snow.$description: Snow — Page canvas background; off-white with the faintest cool tint to soften the page without going gray

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, button text on dark fills, and nav background; pure white for maximum contrast

midnight-steel.$description: Midnight Steel — Dark surface accent borders; used as outline color on dark elements

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Nav and UI utility text; near-black neutral

jet.$description: Jet — Stroke color for illustrations and decorative SVG linework; cool dark gray

inter.$description: Universal UI and body typeface. Handles navigation, body copy, button labels, badges, card descriptions, and all interface text. Weight 400 for body, 500 for emphasized text and labels, 600 for buttons and nav, 700 for high-emphasis callouts. The tight -0.005em tracking at body sizes keeps dense text crisp without feeling mechanical.

abc-normal.$description: Display and heading typeface. Custom geometric grotesque with tight tracking (-0.02em) and aggressive sizing from 24px subheadings up to 88px hero display. Weight 600 for maximum impact headlines, 500 for sub-headings. The negative letter-spacing and sharp geometric forms give the brand its architectural, almost engineering-drawing feel. Substitute: Space Grotesk, then Plus Jakarta Sans.

abc-normal-regular.$description: ABC Normal Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
